quoted_text: Germany Tantau Circle of life , smell good , light orange. Big flowers 8-10cm. This is the one gallon pot. You can repot it in 2-3 gallon pot when you see many white roots appear the bottom of pots. There are several kinds of English rose preorders , like Olive, Boscobel,Jubilee celebrations ,lady of shalott, Benjamin Britten,Ambridge, and so on. English weeding cutting rose Juliet ,Constance, Edith, Tess and so on,a...
